title: AI-free features now available
summary: Hide AI on the site, and subscribe to an AI-free RSS feed.
content:
For those of you not into AI, there are a handful of new features. There's a setting on your new homepage that, when checked, will hide most AI content on the site.

I'm not promising that you'll never see the letters 'AI'. But posts and pages that are predominantly about AI will be hidden. These posts are also hidden from your search results.

AI-free RSS feed

That setting doesn't carry across to the public RSS feed, so if you want the AI-free feed, resubscribe to https://johnnydecimal.com/rss-no-ai.xml.
